packageRules.description: Group non-major Rust crate updates, as Dependabot's rust group did.
Group non-major updates to the web UI's npm packages.
Group GitHub Actions updates; they stay pinned to commit SHAs.
Fedora base images: a new Fedora release is a deliberate move made by hand, never a branched or Rawhide image. Within a release the tags float on purpose, and the monthly rebuild tracks them.
The Quadlet units name images by placeholders that the build fills in (Image=@KEA_IMAGE@); there is nothing to update.
Commit as build(deps): for every update. Last, so it overrides the fix/chore split that config:recommended applies by dependency type.
